ctgov.note: No registered trials with Ernexa as sponsor

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Per FY2025 10-K, Ernexa is a 'preclinical-stage synthetic allogeneic iMSC therapy company' (induced pluripotent stem cell-derived mesenchymal stem cells). Lead candidate ERNA-101 (IL-7/IL-15-secreting iMSCs for platinum-resistant ovarian cancer) had a successful pre-IND meeting with the FDA in Q4 2025; the company expects to complete IND-enabling studies and submit the IND in 2026, then enter a Phase 1 investigator-sponsored trial in 2H 2026. Second candidate ERNA-201 (IL-10-secreting iMSCs for rheumatoid arthritis/autoimmune) is earlier-stage. Technology in-licensed from Factor Bioscience Limited (Sept 2024). No active P1/P2/P3 trials at snapshot date.

excluded_preclinical.stage: Pre-IND complete Q4 2025; IND submission planned 2026; Phase 1 IIT planned 2H 2026

excluded_preclinical.indication: Rheumatoid arthritis and other autoimmune disorders (IL-10-secreting iMSCs)
